report.summary: crates/font-engine: FT-031 rev 4. Added tests/ttc_adversarial.rs (one table-driven test, 14 hostile buffers run through collection_layout inside catch_unwind: truncated mid-header/mid-directory, numFonts/numTables at u32/u16 max, face offset past EOF, table offset+length overrun, zero-length table, misaligned offsets, non-ascending directory order, all-zero-bytes file, empty/single-byte buffers) - every case asserted Error::Malformed, never a panic. Two cases exposed real rev-3 gaps, now fixed in face_layout/collection_layout: an unchecked sfnt version (an all-zero buffer parsed as a trivial valid zero-table sfnt) and unrejected zero-length tables/misaligned offsets/non-ascending tag order. Verified the new checks against all 128 .ttc/.ttf/.otf files under /System/Library/Fonts(/Supplemental): zero anomalies before or after. Added tests/ttc_identity.rs: 3 tests pinning the entire CollectionLayout (every sfnt_offset, every TableRange tag/offset/length) via assert_eq! against literal values, not shape checks; FaceLayout/CollectionLayout now derive PartialEq/Eq. Wired the rev-3-flagged parse_with_source follow-up in: duplicate table tags and overlapping table ranges now reject with Error::Malformed instead of the BTreeMap silently overwriting/ignoring them; verified against 787 real faces (723 Ok/10 MissingTable/54 Unsupported/0 Malformed, identical before and after). cargo test 77/77 (was 73), cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean, cargo fmt --check clean.
